recipes.name: Black Bean Tacos
recipes.desc: Spiced black beans, corn tortillas, avocado, pickled onion, cilantro
recipe: Quick-pickle onion in lime juice and salt 10 min.
Heat beans with cumin, chili powder, salt. Mash slightly.
Warm tortillas in dry skillet.
Fill with beans, avocado, pickled onion, cilantro, salsa.
recipes.tip: Quick-pickle the onions for at least 15 minutes - longer is better. The lime juice turns them bright pink and mellows their raw sharpness into something sweet and tangy.

recipes.name: Chickpea Tikka Masala
recipes.desc: Chickpeas in rich tomato-spiced sauce, spinach, jasmine rice
recipe: Sauté onion until golden, 5 min. Add garlic and ginger 1 min.
Add tikka masala spice, toast 30 sec.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas. Simmer 10 min.
Stir in coconut milk and spinach. Serve over cauliflower rice, topped with fresh cilantro.
recipes.tip: Add a small pinch of sugar to the tikka sauce. It balances the acidity of the tomatoes and rounds out the spice blend without making it sweet.
recipes.tip2: Toast the spices dry for 30 seconds before adding liquid. You'll know they're ready when the kitchen smells incredible — that's the volatile oils releasing. Don't walk away during this step, they burn fast.
recipe_detailed: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook 5–6 min, stirring occasionally, until golden and soft — not just translucent, you want some color here. It builds sweetness.

Add garlic and ginger and stir 1 min until fragrant. Add the tikka masala spice blend and toast it in the oil for 30 seconds, stirring constantly. The kitchen should smell incredible. Don't walk away — spices burn fast and turn bitter.

Pour in the crushed tomatoes and add the chickpeas. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Add a small pinch of sugar. Cook 10 min, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the color deepens to a rich orange-red.
Stir in coconut milk and spinach. Cook 2–3 min until the spinach wilts and the sauce is creamy and uniform. Taste and adjust salt. Serve over basmati rice with naan for scooping.

recipes.name: Lentil Veggie Soup
recipes.desc: Red lentils, kale, carrots, tomatoes, cumin-turmeric broth
recipe: Sauté onion and carrots 5 min. Add garlic and spices 1 min.
Add lentils, tomatoes, broth. Bring to boil.
Simmer 15 min until lentils are soft.
Stir in kale 3 min. Season and squeeze lemon over top.
recipes.tip: Red lentils break down completely as they cook, naturally thickening the soup. If it gets too thick, thin with a splash of water - don't add more broth, which concentrates salt.
recipes.tip2: Red lentils dissolve completely as they cook — that is by design. They are the thickener. Green or brown lentils hold their shape if you prefer texture; just add 10 more min of simmering.
recipe_detailed: Heat oil in a large pot over medium. Cook onion, carrot, and celery 5-6 min until softened. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
Add cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika. Stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add diced tomatoes, lentils, and broth. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook 20-25 min, stirring occasionally, until lentils are completely soft and have dissolved into the broth, thickening it.
Add any leafy greens and stir until wilted. Squeeze lemon juice in at the end — it brightens the whole soup. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Three Bean Chili
recipes.desc: Black, kidney & pinto beans, tomatoes, peppers, chili spices
recipe: Sauté onion and peppers 5 min. Add garlic and spices 1 min.
Add all beans (drained), tomatoes, tomato sauce.
Simmer 15 min, stirring occasionally.
Season. Serve with avocado, sour cream, cilantro.
recipes.tip: Let the chili sit for 15 minutes off heat before serving. Like any braise, resting allows the flavors to settle and meld - it genuinely tastes better.
recipes.tip2: Don't rush the spices — add them to the hot fat and stir for a full 30-60 seconds before adding liquid. This blooms them in oil, releasing the volatile flavor compounds that make chili taste complex instead of flat.
recipe_detailed: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high. Cook onion and peppers 5-6 min until softened. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
Add all the spices: chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and cayenne. Stir for 30-60 seconds in the hot oil until intensely fragrant.
Add drained beans, crushed tomatoes, and broth. Stir well. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.

Simmer uncovered 25-30 min, stirring occasionally, until the chili thickens and the flavors meld. Taste and adjust seasoning — chili often needs more salt and sometimes a splash of vinegar at the end. Serve with sour cream, shredded cheese, and warm cornbread.

recipes.name: Plant-Based Taco Bowls
recipes.desc: Plant-based ground, black beans, salsa, avocado, romaine
recipe: Cook plant-based ground 5 min, breaking up.
Add taco seasoning + 2 tbsp water, stir 1 min.
Warm beans separately.
Build bowls: romaine, ground, beans, avocado, salsa, lime.
recipes.tip: Cook plant-based meat on high heat without stirring for the first 2 minutes. It needs to develop a crust just like real beef, and won't if you stir constantly.
recipes.tip2: Season the base heavily — whether it is lentils, cauliflower, or a blend, it needs to taste like taco meat on its own before it goes in the bowl. Bland filling makes a bland bowl.
recipe_detailed: Cook your taco base: for lentils, simmer in broth with taco seasoning 20 min until soft. For cauliflower, roast at 425F with taco spices 20 min until caramelized. Season aggressively — it should taste boldly spiced on its own.
Warm black or pinto beans in a pan with cumin, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt. Smash a few beans for a creamier texture.
Cook rice and season with lime juice and fresh cilantro.
Build bowls: rice base, beans, taco filling, salsa, guacamole, shredded cabbage, pickled jalapenos, and sour cream or cashew cream. Squeeze lime over everything.

recipes.name: Red Beans & Rice with Sausage
recipes.desc: Creamy Louisiana red beans with Andouille sausage, the Holy Trinity, and rice
ingredients: 3 cups cooked white or brown rice
recipe: Sauté sausage until browned, 5 min. Remove.
In drippings, cook onion, celery, and bell pepper until soft, 6 min.
Add garlic, thyme, paprika, cayenne, bay leaves. Cook 1 min.
Add beans and broth. Simmer 15 min, smashing some beans for creaminess.
Return sausage, simmer 5 more min. Remove bay leaves. Serve over rice with hot sauce.
recipes.tip: Smashing some beans against the pot is the difference between a watery dish and a creamy, restaurant-style red beans. Use the back of a spoon and press firmly against the pot wall.
recipes.tip2: Smash some of the beans against the side of the pot toward the end. This releases starch and creates a thick, creamy sauce that coats the rice rather than sitting watery around it.
recipe_detailed: Cook the Holy Trinity — onion, celery, and bell pepper — in oil 5-7 min until soft. Add garlic and Andouille sausage, cook 3 min until sausage starts to render.
Add drained beans, broth, bay leaves, thyme, and cayenne. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer. Cook 20-45 min depending on whether using canned or soaked dried beans.
In the last 10 min, smash some beans against the side of the pot until the sauce is thick and creamy. Season with salt, pepper, and a splash of hot sauce.
Serve over white rice. Top with sliced sausage and fresh green onions.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.desc: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce - a Middle Eastern classic that's ready in one pan
ingredients: Crusty bread or pita to serve
recipe: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook onion and pepper until soft, 6 min.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and chili flakes. Cook 1 min.
Pour in crushed tomatoes. Season, simmer 10 min until thickened.
Make 6 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook 5-8 min until whites are set but yolks still runny.
Top with parsley and feta. Serve straight from the pan with bread.
recipes.tip: Don't overcook the eggs - pull them when the whites are just set. Residual heat will finish the yolks.
recipes.tip2: If your sauce looks too thin before adding the eggs, let it simmer uncovered an extra 3–5 min. Eggs need a thick sauce to nestle into — too thin and they spread and cook unevenly.
recipe_detailed: Heat oil in a large, deep skillet or oven-safe pan over medium heat. Add the onion and pepper and cook 6–7 min, stirring occasionally, until fully softened and the onion is translucent. Don't rush this — soft vegetables are the base of the sauce.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and chili flakes. Stir constantly for 1 min — the spices will bloom in the oil and smell intensely fragrant. This is the flavor foundation of the dish.

Pour in the crushed tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and simmer over medium-low heat for 10 min, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and deepens in color. It should be thick enough that a spoon dragged through holds a line for a moment.

Use the back of a spoon to make 6 shallow wells in the sauce. Crack one egg into each well, being careful not to break the yolks. Cover the pan with a lid and cook 5–8 min — check at 5 min. The whites should be fully set and opaque but the yolks should still be soft and jiggly when you gently shake the pan.
Remove from heat immediately and top with parsley, feta, and a drizzle of olive oil. Serve straight from the pan with crusty bread or pita for scooping.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burritos
recipes.desc: Scrambled eggs, crispy potatoes, sausage, and cheese wrapped in a warm flour tortilla
ingredients: 2 cups frozen diced potatoes or hash browns
Salsa and sour cream to serve
recipe: Cook sausage in a skillet, breaking it up, until browned. Remove.
Add potatoes and onion to the same skillet. Cook until golden and crispy, 8-10 min.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Pour into the pan over the potatoes. Scramble until just set.
Return sausage to pan. Mix to combine.
Warm tortillas. Fill each with egg mixture and cheese. Roll tightly. Serve with salsa and sour cream.
recipes.tip: Wrap the burritos in foil and you can make them ahead. They reheat perfectly in the oven at 350°F for 15 min.
recipes.tip2: Toasting the burrito in a dry pan after wrapping seals it shut and adds a satisfying crispy exterior. It also prevents it from unwrapping as you eat.
recipe_detailed: Cook sausage or bacon in a skillet, breaking it up. Remove and leave some fat in the pan.

Whisk eggs with a splash of milk, salt, and pepper. Add to the same pan over medium-low heat. Stir slowly with a spatula — you want large, soft curds. Pull off the heat while they look slightly underdone. Residual heat finishes them.
Warm flour tortillas. Layer down the center: eggs, meat, cheese, potatoes, salsa, and sour cream. Don't overfill or they won't wrap.
Fold sides in first, then roll tightly from the bottom up. Toast the burrito seam-side down in a dry pan 1-2 min per side until golden and sealed.

recipes.name: French Toast Casserole
recipes.desc: Thick-cut brioche soaked in a custard, baked until golden and served with maple syrup
ingredients: 1 loaf brioche or challah, cut thick
recipe: Butter a 9x13 baking dish. Arrange bread slices overlapping in the dish.
Whisk eggs, milk, cream, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Pour over bread. Press down gently.
Cover and refrigerate 30 min (or overnight).
Preheat oven to 350°F. Bake uncovered 35-40 min until golden and puffed.
Dust with powdered sugar. Serve with maple syrup and berries.
recipes.tip: Using day-old bread is key - it absorbs the custard without going soggy. Brioche or challah make this genuinely special.
recipes.tip2: The longer the bread soaks, the more custardy the interior. Assemble the night before and refrigerate — the bread fully saturates and you just bake it in the morning.
recipe_detailed: Tear or slice bread into thick chunks. Day-old bread is better — it is drier and absorbs more custard without getting soggy.
Whisk together eggs, milk, cream, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
Pour custard over bread in a baking dish. Press the bread down gently so every piece soaks up the liquid. Let soak 30 min minimum. Overnight is best.
Bake at 350F for 40-45 min until puffed, golden, and set in the center — a knife inserted in the middle should come out clean. Let rest 5 min before scooping. Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Chicken & Waffle Stack
recipes.desc: Crispy fried chicken on golden Belgian waffles with maple syrup and hot sauce
ingredients: Eggs and oil per waffle mix instructions
recipe: Marinate chicken in buttermilk, salt, and pepper 20 min.
Mix flour with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Dredge chicken pieces.
Fry in 350°F oil, 5-6 min per side until golden and cooked through. Drain on rack.
Make waffles per package instructions.
Stack waffles and chicken. Serve with maple syrup, butter, and hot sauce.
recipes.tip: The contrast of the sweet syrup and the hot sauce is the whole point - don't skip either one.
recipes.tip2: Fry the chicken at 325-350F — not higher. Too hot and the outside burns before the inside cooks. Use a thermometer; consistent oil temperature is the difference between crispy and greasy.
recipe_detailed: Brine chicken pieces in buttermilk for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight. This tenderizes the meat and keeps it moist through frying.
Season flour generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and cayenne. Dredge chicken in the flour, back in buttermilk, then back in flour — the double dredge creates a thick, craggy crust.
Heat 2-3 inches of oil to 325-350F. Fry chicken in batches 12-15 min, turning once, until deep golden and a thermometer reads 165F. Drain on a wire rack.
Make waffles. Stack: waffle, chicken, waffle, chicken. Drizzle with maple syrup and hot sauce.

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.desc: Fried eggs on warm corn tortillas with ranchero sauce, refried beans, and fresh toppings
ingredients: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles
recipe: Make ranchero sauce: sauté onion, jalapeño, and garlic until soft. Add tomatoes, cumin, and broth. Simmer 10 min.
Warm refried beans. Lightly fry tortillas in oil until just crisp at edges.
Fry eggs sunny side up.
Spread beans on tortillas. Top with egg and ranchero sauce.
Finish with avocado, cotija, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.
recipes.tip: If you want to make this faster on a weeknight, use store-bought salsa instead of making the ranchero sauce from scratch.
recipes.tip2: Simmer the ranchero sauce longer than you think — 15 min of simmering concentrates it from thin tomato liquid into a thick, deeply flavored sauce. Don't rush it.
recipe_detailed: Make ranchero sauce: saute onion, jalapeno, and garlic in oil until soft. Add crushed tomatoes, cumin, chili powder, and salt. Simmer 12-15 min until thickened and the color deepens. Taste and adjust heat.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a gas flame. Keep warm wrapped in a towel.
Fry eggs in oil or butter over medium heat. For sunny-side: cover the pan with a lid and cook 2-3 min until whites are set and yolks are still runny.
Assemble: tortilla, spoonful of black beans, egg, ranchero sauce, crumbled cotija or feta, sliced avocado, and fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Hash Brown Egg Bake
recipes.desc: A hearty one-dish dinner: crispy hash brown crust loaded with eggs, bacon, and cheese
ingredients: 1 bag (20 oz) frozen shredded hash browns, thawed
recipe: Preheat oven to 400°F. Grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Toss hash browns with butter, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Press into dish forming a crust. Bake 25 min until golden.
Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper. Pour over crust. Scatter bacon and half the cheese.
Bake 15 min until eggs are set. Top with remaining cheese and melt 2 more min.
Garnish with green onions. Serve with sour cream.
recipes.tip: Fully thaw the hash browns and squeeze out excess moisture - that's what gets you the crispy crust instead of a soggy mess.
recipes.tip2: Press the hash brown layer firmly into the pan and bake it for 15 min before adding eggs. You want it golden and set, not soft — otherwise you get a mushy base instead of a crispy crust.
recipe_detailed: Preheat oven to 400F. Squeeze all moisture out of shredded potatoes in a towel — really wring it out. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Press hash brown mixture firmly into a greased baking dish or cast iron, making an even layer. Bake 15 min until the edges start to turn golden and the center is set.
Meanwhile, cook your mix-ins: saute sausage, peppers, onion, and any vegetables until cooked through.
Spread mix-ins over the hash brown crust. Make wells and crack eggs in. Season eggs. Scatter cheese over everything. Bake 12-15 min until whites are fully set. Let rest 5 min before slicing.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.desc: Quick weeknight fried rice loaded with eggs, vegetables, and soy sauce
recipe: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add garlic, cook 30 seconds. Add peas and carrots, stir fry 2 min.
Push vegetables to the side. Pour in eggs, scramble until just set.
Add rice. Toss everything together over high heat 2-3 min.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper. Toss. Serve with sriracha.
recipes.tip: Day-old refrigerated rice is mandatory - fresh rice is too wet and turns to mush. Make the rice the night before.
recipes.tip2: Day-old cold rice is essential — freshly cooked rice is too moist and clumps. Spread leftover rice on a sheet pan and refrigerate uncovered overnight to dry it out. This single step is why restaurant fried rice beats home attempts.
recipe_detailed: Use cold, day-old rice. Break up any clumps with your hands before adding to the pan.
Heat a wok or large pan over the highest heat you have. Add oil until shimmering. Add the cold rice and spread in an even layer. Don't stir for 1-2 min — let it crisp on the bottom. Toss and repeat.
Push rice to the sides. Add a little more oil to the center, then the eggs. Scramble until just barely set, then toss through the rice.
Add soy sauce, sesame oil, and any vegetables or protein. Toss everything over high heat for 1-2 min until fragrant. Finish with green onions.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Frittata
recipes.desc: A light oven-baked Italian egg dish with smoked salmon, cream cheese, and fresh dill
recipe: Preheat oven to 375°F. Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet. Cook red onion 3 min until soft.
Pour in egg mixture. Arrange salmon, cream cheese dollops, capers, and dill on top.
Cook on stove 2 min until edges set, then transfer to oven.
Bake 12-15 min until center is just set. Slice into wedges and serve with lemon.
recipes.tip: Don't overbake - a frittata should still have a slight jiggle in the center when you pull it. It firms as it rests.
recipes.tip2: Don't beat the eggs too aggressively — overbeaten eggs are rubbery. Whisk just until the yolks and whites are combined. Some visible streaks are fine; they even out during cooking.
recipe_detailed: Preheat oven broiler to high. Whisk eggs with cream, salt, and pepper just until combined.
Heat an oven-safe skillet over medium. Add butter and cook shallots until soft, 2-3 min. Add capers and any other fillings.
Pour in the egg mixture. Cook undisturbed over medium-low for 4-5 min until the edges are set but the center is still slightly jiggly.

Scatter smoked salmon and cream cheese over the top. Transfer to the broiler for 2-3 min until just set and lightly golden. Watch closely — it goes from perfect to rubbery quickly. Slide onto a plate, top with fresh dill and lemon zest.

recipes.name: Pancake Dinner Board
recipes.desc: A fun spread of fluffy buttermilk pancakes with maple syrup, fruit, whipped cream, and bacon
recipe: Cook bacon until crispy. Set aside.
Whisk dry ingredients. In another bowl, mix buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter. Combine wet and dry - don't overmix.
Heat a griddle to medium. Butter lightly. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form, flip, cook 1 min more.
Arrange on a large board or platter with bacon, berries, whipped cream, and syrup.
Serve immediately and let everyone build their own stack.
recipes.tip: Lumpy batter is good batter - overmixing develops gluten and makes pancakes tough. Mix until just combined.
recipes.tip2: Let the batter rest 5 min after mixing — the baking powder activates fully and the gluten relaxes, giving you fluffier, more tender pancakes. Don't skip this.
recipe_detailed: Mix dry ingredients in one bowl. Mix wet ingredients in another. Combine wet into dry and stir until just combined — lumps are fine. Overmixing develops gluten and makes tough pancakes.
Let batter rest 5 min while you heat the griddle to medium. A drop of water should sizzle and dance. Lightly grease with butter.
Pour batter in circles. When bubbles form across the whole surface and the edges look matte, flip. Cook 1-2 min on the second side.
Build the board: stack pancakes in the center, surround with toppings — berries, sliced banana, whipped cream, maple syrup, chocolate chips, and powdered sugar. Let everyone customize.

recipes.name: Biscuits & Gravy
recipes.desc: Southern-style fluffy biscuits smothered in creamy sausage gravy
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
recipe: Preheat oven to 450°F. Mix flour, baking powder, and salt. Cut in cold butter until crumbly. Add buttermilk, mix until just combined.
Drop biscuits onto a parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake 12-14 min until golden.
Cook sausage in a skillet over medium-high, breaking it up. Don't drain the fat.
Sprinkle flour over sausage. Stir and cook 1 min. Slowly whisk in milk. Simmer until thick, 4-5 min. Season generously.
Split biscuits and smother with gravy.
recipes.tip: The fat from the sausage is what makes the gravy. Don't drain it - that's the flavor.
recipes.tip2: Cold butter in biscuits is non-negotiable. Warm butter melts into the dough and you lose the flakiness. Freeze the butter and grate it in, or cut it in quickly and keep everything cold.
recipe_detailed: For biscuits: mix flour, baking powder, salt. Cut in very cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in cold buttermilk until just combined.
Turn out on a floured surface, pat to 1-inch thickness. Fold in half and pat again — this creates layers. Cut straight down with a sharp cutter, no twisting. Bake at 425F for 12-14 min until golden.

For gravy: cook sausage in a skillet until browned and crumbly. Sprinkle flour directly over the meat and stir 1-2 min to cook out the raw flour taste. Pour in milk slowly, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Simmer gravy 5 min until thick and creamy. Season aggressively with black pepper. Split biscuits and ladle gravy generously over.

recipes.name: Saag Paneer
recipes.desc: Indian creamed spinach with golden pan-fried paneer cheese - rich, aromatic, and warming
ingredients: 1 lb fresh spinach or frozen spinach, thawed
1/2 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
Naan or basmati rice to serve
recipe: Pan-fry paneer cubes in ghee until golden on all sides. Set aside.
In the same pan, toast cumin seeds until fragrant. Add onion, cook until golden, 8 min.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, chili powder. Cook 2 min. Add spinach, cook until wilted.
Blend or mash the spinach mixture to a rough puree. Return to pan.
Add cream, garam masala, and paneer. Simmer 5 min. Serve with naan.
recipes.tip: Blending half the spinach and leaving the rest chunky gives you the best texture - not too smooth, not too rough.
recipes.tip2: Frying the paneer first until golden gives it a slightly firm exterior that holds up in the sauce. Skip this step and it turns soft and crumbly. Either is delicious, but golden paneer holds its shape.
recipe_detailed: Cut paneer into cubes and pan-fry in oil over medium-high heat 2-3 min per side until golden. Remove and set aside.
Wilt spinach in the same pan with a splash of water. Once cooled, blend to a rough puree — some texture is nice.
In the same pan, heat ghee or oil. Add onion, cook 5 min until golden. Add garlic, ginger, and spices. Cook 1 min — they should smell intensely fragrant.
Add the spinach puree and cream. Simmer 5 min until the flavors meld. Fold in the paneer gently. Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with basmati rice and warm naan.

recipes.name: Mushroom Bourguignon
recipes.desc: A hearty French stew with mushrooms, carrots, and red wine - vegetarian comfort at its finest
ingredients: Mashed potatoes or crusty bread to serve
recipe: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Brown mushrooms in batches over high heat until golden. Remove.
Cook onion and carrots until soft. Add garlic, tomato paste, and flour. Cook 1 min.
Pour in wine and deglaze. Add broth, thyme, and bay leaves. Simmer 10 min.
Return mushrooms. Simmer 20 min until sauce is rich and vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaves. Serve over mashed potatoes.
recipes.tip: Brown the mushrooms in batches over really high heat - crowding the pan steams them instead of browning them.
recipes.tip2: Don't add salt to mushrooms at the start — it draws out water and they steam instead of sear. Cook them dry until the liquid evaporates, then season. That is when they start to brown.
recipe_detailed: Heat oil and butter in a large Dutch oven over high heat. Add mushrooms in a single layer — work in batches. Cook without stirring 3-4 min until they release their liquid and it evaporates, then they start to brown. Season with salt once golden.
Remove mushrooms. In the same pot over medium, cook onion, carrot, and celery 5 min. Add garlic and tomato paste, cook 1 min.
Add red wine and let it bubble and reduce by half — about 5 min. Scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom. Add broth and herbs.
Return mushrooms to the pot. Simmer 20 min until sauce reduces and thickens. Stir in butter for gloss. Serve over mashed potatoes or with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Korean Bibimbap (Veg)
recipes.desc: Korean rice bowl topped with sautéed vegetables, a fried egg, and gochujang chili paste
recipe: Blanch spinach and bean sprouts separately 1 min. Drain and season each with sesame oil, garlic, salt.
Sauté zucchini, carrot, and mushrooms separately with a little oil and soy. Each should be tender but not mushy.
Fry eggs sunny side up.
Divide warm rice into bowls. Arrange vegetables in sections. Top with egg and gochujang.
Drizzle with sesame oil and sesame seeds. Mix everything together before eating.
recipes.tip: The whole point is to mix everything together - crack that egg yolk and stir until the rice turns a beautiful orange color.
recipes.tip2: The crispy rice is the point of bibimbap. Heat the bowl or skillet until very hot before adding the rice, and let it sit undisturbed for 2-3 min to form a crust on the bottom. That crunch is what makes it.
recipe_detailed: Prepare each vegetable separately: blanch or saute spinach, carrots, zucchini, and bean sprouts with a little sesame oil and garlic. Keep each component separate and seasoned.
Cook rice. Heat a stone bowl or cast iron skillet over high heat. Add sesame oil, then the rice, pressing it in. Let it sit undisturbed 2-3 min — you should hear it crackling as a crust forms.
Arrange vegetables in sections over the rice. Make a well in the center and add a fried or raw egg yolk. Add a spoonful of gochujang.
At the table, mix everything vigorously — the hot rice cooks the egg, the gochujang spreads through, and the crispy rice bits distribute throughout.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.desc: Punjabi spiced chickpeas in a tangy tomato sauce - one of India's great street food dishes
ingredients: 1 tsp amchur (dry mango powder) or lemon juice
recipe: Heat oil in a pan. Toast cumin seeds until they splutter.
Add onion, cook until dark golden, 10 min. Add garlic and ginger. Cook 2 min.
Add all spices except garam masala. Stir, add tomatoes. Cook until oil separates, 8 min.
Add chickpeas and 1/2 cup water. Simmer 10 min until sauce thickens.
Add garam masala and amchur. Stir. Serve with cilantro and rice.
recipes.tip: Cooking the onions until they're truly golden (not just soft) is the foundation of the dish's depth. Don't rush this step.
recipes.tip2: Mash about a quarter of the chickpeas against the side of the pot with a spoon partway through simmering. This thickens the sauce naturally and gives it body without any flour or cream.
recipe_detailed: Heat oil in a large pot over medium. Cook onion 6-8 min until deeply golden. Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 min.
Add cumin seeds, coriander, turmeric, garam masala, and chili powder. Stir for 30 seconds — they should bloom and become intensely fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes and a pinch of sugar. Cook 5 min until the tomatoes darken slightly. Add drained chickpeas and broth. Simmer 15 min.
Use the back of a spoon to mash about a quarter of the chickpeas against the pot's side to thicken the sauce. Add a squeeze of lemon. Serve over basmati rice with fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Caprese Gnocchi
recipes.desc: Pillowy potato gnocchi with cherry tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil in a light sauce
recipe: Cook gnocchi in salted boiling water until they float, about 2-3 min. Drain.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add garlic and cherry tomatoes. Cook until tomatoes begin to burst, 4-5 min.
Add gnocchi to the pan. Toss and let them get a little golden, 2 min.
Remove from heat. Fold in mozzarella and basil.
Season, drizzle with balsamic glaze, and serve immediately.
recipes.tip: Let the gnocchi sit in the pan after adding them - don't stir immediately. That contact time is what gets you the golden crust.
recipes.tip2: Pan-frying the gnocchi instead of boiling gives them a crispy shell and chewy interior. Use a non-stick pan and don't move them for 2 min per side.
recipe_detailed: Pan-fry store-bought gnocchi directly in an oiled non-stick skillet over medium-high for 2-3 min per side until golden and crispy. No boiling needed.
In the same pan, heat olive oil and add halved cherry tomatoes. Cook 3-4 min until they burst and release their juices. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Return gnocchi to the pan. Add fresh mozzarella and toss gently — you want it just barely melted.
Finish with torn fresh basil, a drizzle of good olive oil, and flaky salt. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Roasted Veggie Grain Bowl
recipes.desc: A hearty bowl of farro or quinoa, roasted seasonal vegetables, tahini dressing, and chickpeas
recipe: Cook farro per package directions. Season with salt.
Toss vegetables and chickpeas with olive oil, za'atar, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast at 425°F, 25 min.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and water until smooth and pourable. Season with salt.
Build bowls: grain base, roasted veg and chickpeas, tahini drizzle.
Top with fresh parsley.
recipes.tip: Za'atar on roasted vegetables is genuinely transformative - worth buying if you don't have it.
recipes.tip2: Roast vegetables on a very hot pan at 425F with plenty of space between pieces. Crowding causes steaming — you want caramelization on the edges, not softened veg sitting in its own steam.
recipe_detailed: Preheat oven to 425F. Cut vegetables into similar-sized pieces. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer on a sheet pan — leave space between pieces.
Roast 25-30 min, flipping halfway, until edges are caramelized and vegetables are tender with some golden-brown spots.
Cook farro, quinoa, or your chosen grain. Season the warm grain with olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.
Build bowls: grain base, roasted vegetables, a dollop of hummus, sliced avocado. Top with seeds or nuts for crunch and drizzle with tahini dressing or lemon vinaigrette.

recipes.name: Tofu Tikka Masala
recipes.desc: Crispy pan-fried tofu in a luscious tikka masala sauce - all the restaurant flavors, plant-based
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu, pressed and cubed
2 tbsp tikka masala or curry paste
recipe: Press tofu 15 min. Cube and pan-fry in oil until golden on all sides, 8-10 min. Set aside.
In the same pan, sauté onion until golden. Add garlic, ginger, and tikka paste. Cook 2 min.
Add crushed tomatoes. Simmer 8 min until thickened.
Add coconut cream, garam masala, cumin. Simmer 5 min. Fold in tofu.
Serve over rice with cilantro.
recipes.tip: Pressing the tofu removes moisture so it crisps instead of steams. A clean dish towel and a heavy pan for 15 min does the job.
recipes.tip2: Press the tofu for at least 30 min before cooking. Unpressed tofu holds water and won't crisp in the pan; pressed tofu sears beautifully.
recipe_detailed: Press tofu: wrap in a clean towel, place something heavy on top, and let sit 30 min. Cut into cubes. Toss with oil and tikka seasoning.
Pan-fry tofu in a hot non-stick skillet 3-4 min per side until golden and slightly crispy on the outside. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, saute onion 5 min until golden. Add garlic, ginger, and tikka masala spice blend, cook 1 min. Add crushed tomatoes, cook 8 min until thickened.
Stir in coconut milk and simmer 5 min. Add the tofu and warm through 2 min. Serve over basmati rice with naan and fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
recipes.desc: Rich, deeply caramelized onion broth topped with crusty baguette and broiled Gruyère
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry white wine or sherry
recipe: Melt butter and oil in a Dutch oven over medium. Add onions and sugar. Cook, stirring every 5-10 min, for 45 min until deep golden brown.
Add wine and cook until absorbed. Add broth, thyme, and bay leaf. Simmer 15 min. Season.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls. Top with baguette slices and Gruyère.
Broil 3-4 min until cheese is bubbly and golden.
Serve immediately.
recipes.tip: 45 minutes for the onions is not an exaggeration. Rushing this step is the most common mistake. Low and slow is the only way.
recipes.tip2: Truly caramelized onions take 45 min to 1 hour over low heat. If a recipe says 10 min, those are not caramelized — they are just cooked. The long, slow cook transforms them from sharp and pungent to sweet and deeply savory.
recipe_detailed: Melt butter in a large heavy pot over medium-low. Add thinly sliced onions and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring every 5-10 min, for 45-60 min until they shrink dramatically and turn deep amber-brown. Don't rush this.
Add garlic and thyme, cook 1 min. Deglaze with white wine or sherry, scraping up all the caramelized bits. Let the wine reduce almost completely.
Add beef broth and simmer 15-20 min. Season with salt and pepper — the broth should be deeply savory and sweet.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls. Top with toasted baguette slices and a very generous amount of Gruyere cheese. Broil 3-4 min until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and starting to brown.

recipes.name: Spanakopita Bake
recipes.desc: Greek spinach and feta pie baked in crispy phyllo - easier than it looks and absolutely delicious
ingredients: 1 lb frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
recipe: Preheat oven to 375°F. Mix spinach, feta, eggs, dill, onions, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Brush a 9x13 baking dish with butter. Layer 6 phyllo sheets, brushing each with butter.
Spread spinach filling evenly.
Layer remaining 6 phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with butter. Score top into portions with a sharp knife.
Bake 40-45 min until deeply golden. Cool 10 min before cutting.
recipes.tip: Squeeze the spinach as dry as you possibly can - excess water will make the bottom layers soggy.
recipes.tip2: Brush every single layer of phyllo with butter — each buttered layer crisps separately and creates that signature shattering flakiness. A dry layer of phyllo turns into cardboard.
recipe_detailed: Thaw phyllo dough completely before using. Keep it covered with a damp towel while you work — it dries out and becomes brittle within minutes of air exposure.
Squeeze all liquid from the wilted spinach — really wring it out. Mix squeezed spinach with crumbled feta, ricotta, eggs, onion, garlic, nutmeg, and salt.
Butter a baking dish. Layer 6-8 sheets of phyllo on the bottom, brushing each one generously with melted butter. Spread filling evenly. Layer 6-8 more sheets on top, each buttered.
Score the top layers with a sharp knife before baking. Bake at 375F for 35-40 min until deep golden brown.

recipes.name: Turkish Menemen
recipes.desc: A beloved Turkish breakfast - soft scrambled eggs cooked in spiced tomato and pepper sauce
recipe: Heat oil over medium. Cook onion 5 min. Add peppers, cook 3 min.
Add tomatoes, pepper flakes, cumin, salt. Cook until tomatoes break down, 8 min.
Crack eggs directly into the pan. Stir very gently to create a soft, custardy scramble.
Top with parsley and feta. Serve with bread.
recipes.tip: Menemen should be soft and slightly runny - pull off heat while still a little underdone.
recipes.tip2: Menemen is a soft-scrambled egg dish — it should be creamy and custardy, not dry and rubbery. Stir constantly over medium-low heat and pull it while it still looks slightly underdone. Residual heat finishes it.
recipe_detailed: Heat olive oil in a wide pan over medium. Add onion and green pepper and cook 5-6 min until completely soft. Add garlic and cook 1 min.
Add diced tomatoes and season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Cook 8-10 min until tomatoes break down into a thick sauce.

Crack eggs directly into the sauce. Stir gently and constantly with a spatula over medium-low heat, folding the eggs through the tomatoes as they set. Cook until the eggs are just barely set — soft, silky curds. Remove from heat while they still look slightly underdone.
Crumble feta over the top and add fresh herbs. Serve straight from the pan with crusty bread for scooping.

recipes.name: Croque Madame
recipes.desc: The French classic - ham and gruyère sandwich smothered in béchamel and topped with a fried egg
recipe: Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour 1 min. Add milk slowly, simmer until thick. Add mustard, nutmeg, salt.
Spread béchamel on bread. Layer ham and Gruyère. Grill in buttered pan 2-3 min per side until golden.
Top with remaining béchamel and Gruyère. Broil 2-3 min until bubbling. Fry eggs sunny-side up. Place one on each sandwich.
recipes.tip: The béchamel on top is what makes this special. Broil until properly bubbling and golden brown.
recipes.tip2: Bechamel is just a roux cooked into milk — stir constantly and don't stop. If lumps form, keep stirring over heat; they usually dissolve. If they don't, push the sauce through a sieve.
recipe_detailed: Make bechamel: melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add flour and stir constantly for 1-2 min. Pour in warm milk slowly while whisking. Cook 3-4 min until thickened enough to coat a spoon. Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Butter two slices of bread. Spread Dijon on the inside faces. Layer with ham and Gruyere. Close the sandwich and butter the outside too.
Cook in a skillet over medium heat 3-4 min per side until golden. Spread bechamel over the top and add more Gruyere. Transfer to a baking sheet and broil 2-3 min until bubbly and spotted brown.
Fry an egg sunny-side up with a runny yolk. Place on top of the finished sandwich. Eat immediately.

recipes.name: Congee with Toppings
recipes.desc: Silky Chinese rice porridge with soft-boiled eggs, scallion, ginger, and sesame oil
recipe: Combine rice, broth, water, ginger, garlic. Bring to boil. Reduce to a low simmer.
Cook uncovered 30-40 min, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down into thick creamy porridge.
Season with salt and white pepper. Ladle into bowls. Top with egg, green onion, sesame oil, soy sauce, and chili oil.
recipes.tip: More water (up to 10:1) makes it silkier. It looks thin hot but thickens as it cools.
recipes.tip2: The ratio for congee is 1 cup rice to 8-10 cups water or broth — much more liquid than regular rice. The grains need to fully break down into a creamy porridge. Stir occasionally and it gets there over 45-60 min.
recipe_detailed: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Combine rice, broth, ginger, and any aromatics in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce to the lowest possible simmer.
Cook 45-60 min, stirring every 10 min to prevent sticking, until the rice has completely broken down into a smooth, creamy porridge. Add more broth or water if it gets too thick.
Season the congee with salt and white pepper. Taste — it should be subtly savory and comforting on its own.
Serve in deep bowls with a spread of toppings: soft-boiled eggs, sliced green onion, fried shallots, crispy garlic, sesame oil, soy sauce, white pepper, and chili oil.

recipes.name: Israeli Breakfast Spread
recipes.desc: A Mediterranean spread of hummus, Israeli salad, labneh, olives, and jammy eggs with warm pita
recipe: Boil eggs 7 min. Ice bath 5 min, peel.
Combine cucumbers, tomatoes, red onion, parsley, lemon, oil, salt for salad.
Arrange hummus, labneh, olives, and salad on a platter. Halve eggs and nestle in. Drizzle with za'atar and olive oil.
Serve with warm pita.
recipes.tip: Israeli breakfast is meant to be social - put everything in the center and let people graze.
recipes.tip2: The quality of an Israeli breakfast is entirely in the produce — peak-season tomatoes and cucumbers make or break it. Salt the tomato pieces lightly and let them sit 5 min so they release juice, then drain before adding to the salad.
recipe_detailed: Make Israeli salad: dice cucumber and tomato into very small pieces, about 5mm cubes. Add finely diced red onion, flat-leaf parsley, lemon juice, olive oil, and salt. The small cut is essential. Toss and let sit 5 min.
Soft-boil eggs: into boiling water for exactly 7 min, then ice bath. Peel when cool — the yolk should be set at the edges and jammy in the center.
Arrange the spread: a big bowl of salad, halved eggs, sliced cucumber, good quality olives, labneh or thick yogurt drizzled with olive oil, hummus, and warm pita or fresh bread.
The idea is everything on the table at once — no formal plating. Tear bread and eat mezze-style.

recipes.name: Ham & Cheese Savory Crepes
recipes.desc: Thin French crepes filled with ham, egg, and melted Gruyère - a Paris street food classic
recipe: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, and salt into smooth batter. Rest 15 min.
Heat nonstick skillet. Add butter. Pour 1/4 cup batter, tilt to coat thinly. Cook 1-2 min, flip, cook 30 sec.
Return crepe to pan. Add ham and Gruyère to half. Crack egg on top. Fold to half-moon. Cook 2-3 min until set.
Garnish with chives.
recipes.tip: Resting the batter relaxes gluten - gives thin, elastic crepes that don't tear when folded.
recipes.tip2: Crepe batter needs to rest 30 min before cooking — the gluten relaxes and the batter thins slightly. Rested batter makes smooth, flexible crepes; fresh batter tears.
recipe_detailed: Make batter: blend eggs, milk, flour, butter, and a pinch of salt until completely smooth. Let rest 30 min at room temperature — this is essential.

Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high. Brush with a thin film of butter. Pour in just enough batter to coat the pan thinly — tilt and swirl immediately to spread it before it sets. Cook 1-2 min until the edges look dry and lift slightly, then flip for 30 seconds.
Fill each crepe with sliced ham, Gruyere, and a spoonful of Dijon. Fold in half, then in half again. Return to the pan to melt the cheese.
Optionally top with a fried egg and a handful of dressed greens. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Bowl
recipes.desc: Roasted sweet potatoes with fried eggs, black beans, avocado, and chipotle crema
recipe: Toss sweet potato with oil, paprika, cumin, salt. Roast at 425°F 25 min until caramelized.
Warm black beans. Stir together sour cream, chipotle, lime for crema. Fry eggs.
Build bowls: sweet potato, beans, egg, avocado, crema, cilantro, hot sauce.
recipes.tip: Roast cut-side down without stirring the first 15 min for caramelized edges, not steamed pieces.
recipes.tip2: Roasted sweet potato is far better than microwaved for this bowl — the dry heat caramelizes the natural sugars and creates a deeper, sweeter flavor. Cube it and roast at 425F while everything else comes together.
recipe_detailed: Cube sweet potato and toss with oil, salt, and cinnamon. Roast at 425F for 20-25 min until caramelized on the edges and tender throughout.
Soft-boil or fry your eggs to preference. While they cook, cook breakfast sausage or bacon if using.
Prepare toppings: slice avocado, wash greens, toast nuts, and prepare any sauces such as tahini or maple-sriracha.
Build the bowl: sweet potato as the base, greens, egg, protein, avocado. Drizzle with tahini or maple-sriracha sauce.

recipes.name: Dutch Baby Pancake
recipes.desc: A dramatic puffed oven pancake served with lemon, powdered sugar, and fresh berries
recipe: Preheat oven to 425°F with a 10-inch cast iron skillet inside.
Blend eggs, milk, flour, sugar, vanilla, and salt until very smooth. Rest 5 min.
Remove hot skillet. Add butter - sizzles immediately. Swirl to coat. Pour in all batter at once. Return to oven.
Bake 20 min without opening. Dust with powdered sugar, squeeze lemon, top with berries.
recipes.tip: Room temperature eggs and milk are essential - cold ingredients prevent the dramatic puff.
recipes.tip2: The pan must be screaming hot when the batter goes in — preheat it in the oven at 425F for 10 min. The thermal shock from cold batter hitting the hot pan is what creates the dramatic puff and crispy, custardy edges.
recipe_detailed: Place a cast iron skillet in the oven and preheat to 425F for at least 10 min — the pan must be very hot.
While the pan heats, blend eggs, milk, flour, vanilla, and a pinch of salt until completely smooth. The batter should be thin.
When the pan is very hot, carefully add butter and swirl to coat. Immediately pour in all the batter at once — it should sizzle as it hits the pan.
Bake 18-22 min without opening the oven door — peeking causes it to deflate. Serve immediately dusted with powdered sugar and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Smashed Potato Breakfast Skillet
recipes.desc: Crispy smashed potatoes with caramelized onions, bacon, and runny eggs in a cast iron skillet
recipe: Cook bacon until crispy. Remove, keep fat. Add oil. Smash potatoes flat. Cook undisturbed 4-5 min until golden. Flip.
Add onion and garlic around potatoes. Cook until golden. Season with paprika, salt, pepper.
Make 4 wells. Crack an egg into each. Bake at 400°F 6-8 min. Top with bacon and chives. Serve with sour cream or hot sauce on the side.
recipes.tip: Don't stir the potatoes for the first 5 min - that contact time builds the crust.
recipes.tip2: Boil the potatoes all the way through before smashing and frying — they should be cooked completely, not al dente. Undercooked potatoes don't smash flat and won't crisp evenly.
recipe_detailed: Boil small potatoes until completely tender — a fork should slide through with zero resistance. Drain and let steam dry for 5 min.
Heat oil in a large cast iron over medium-high. Place potatoes in the pan and smash each one flat with the bottom of a glass or a spatula. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Cook undisturbed 4-5 min until the bottom is deeply golden and crispy. Flip and cook 3 more min. Remove to a plate.

In the same pan, cook breakfast sausage or bacon. Add peppers and onions and cook until softened. Return potatoes. Make wells and add eggs. Cover and cook until whites are set. Scatter cheese and serve straight from the pan.

recipes.name: Japanese Miso Breakfast Bowl
recipes.desc: A traditional Japanese breakfast - warm miso soup with tofu alongside steamed rice, pickles, and nori
recipe: Heat dashi over medium - do not boil. Dissolve miso in a ladle of warm dashi, whisk back in.
Add tofu and wakame. Warm 2 min. Top with green onion.
Serve alongside warm rice with pickles, nori, and soy sauce.
recipes.tip: Miso must never boil - it kills the probiotics and dulls the flavor. Always dissolve in a ladle of warm broth first.
recipes.tip2: Never boil miso — add it off the heat or in water below simmering. Boiling destroys the beneficial enzymes and mutes the delicate, complex flavor.
recipe_detailed: Cook rice the night before if possible — cold rice is better for this bowl since it firms up and separates more easily.
Make miso soup: bring dashi or water to a near-simmer, not boiling. Remove from heat. Whisk in miso paste until dissolved. Add cubed silken tofu and wakame seaweed. Keep warm but don't boil.
Soft-boil an egg: 7 min in boiling water, then ice bath, then peel. Optionally marinate peeled egg in soy sauce, mirin, and water for 1 hour.
Assemble: warm rice, miso soup on the side, halved egg, pickled ginger, nori strips, sliced green onion, and a drizzle of sesame oil.

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmigiana
recipes.desc: Classic Italian baked eggplant in tomato sauce layered with mozzarella and parmesan
recipe: Salt eggplant slices, let sit 20 min, pat dry. Dredge: flour → egg → breadcrumbs. Fry in olive oil until golden, 2 min per side.
Layer in baking dish: marinara, eggplant, mozzarella, parmesan. Repeat.
Bake at 400°F 25 min until bubbling. Rest 10 min. Top with basil.
recipes.tip: Salting and pressing the eggplant removes water so slices crisp instead of steam. Paper towels and something heavy for 20 min.
recipes.tip2: Salt the eggplant slices and let them sit for 30 min before cooking — they release bitter water and absorb far less oil during frying. Rinse and pat completely dry before breading.
recipe_detailed: Slice eggplant into half-inch rounds. Salt both sides and spread on a rack for 30 min — you will see water bead on the surface. Rinse thoroughly and pat completely dry.
Set up a breading station: flour, beaten eggs, and seasoned breadcrumbs. Dredge eggplant in flour, then egg, then press firmly into breadcrumbs.
Fry in half an inch of oil over medium-high, 2-3 min per side, until deep golden. Drain on a wire rack.
Layer in a baking dish: marinara, eggplant, mozzarella, Parmesan. Repeat layers, ending with cheese. Bake at 375F for 25-30 min until bubbly and golden. Rest 10 min before serving.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry (Veg)
recipes.desc: Fragrant Thai green curry with tofu, zucchini, and Thai basil in creamy coconut broth
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu, pressed and cubed
recipe: Pan-fry tofu in coconut oil until golden, 8 min. Remove. Fry curry paste 1-2 min. Add one can coconut milk.
Add broth and second can coconut milk. Add vegetables. Season with soy, sugar, lime.
Add tofu and Thai basil. Serve over jasmine rice.
recipes.tip: Fry the curry paste in oil before adding liquid - this blooms the aromatics and is the step most home cooks skip.
recipes.tip2: Fry the green curry paste in coconut cream until the oil separates — you will see it start to pool around the paste. This cracking step blooms the paste and is where the soup transitions from flat to deeply layered.
recipe_detailed: Open the coconut milk and spoon the thick cream from the top into the pan. Heat over medium until simmering. Add green curry paste and fry in the cream 2-3 min, stirring constantly, until the oil separates and pools around the paste.
Add the thinner coconut milk, broth, and fish sauce or soy sauce to keep it vegan. Stir to combine and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add denser vegetables first and simmer 5-7 min. Add quick-cooking vegetables in the last 2 min.
Squeeze lime juice in at the very end. Taste — it should be fragrant, slightly spicy, and balanced. Serve over jasmine rice with extra lime wedges.

recipes.name: Roasted Beet & Feta Salad
recipes.desc: Roasted beets with creamy goat cheese, candied walnuts, and honey-dijon dressing over arugula
recipe: Wrap beets in foil. Roast at 400°F 45 min. Cool, peel, slice.
Toss walnuts with 1 tbsp honey. Toast in dry pan 3 min until caramelized.
Whisk oil, balsamic, Dijon, 2 tbsp honey, salt for dressing. Toss arugula with half. Arrange beets. Add goat cheese and walnuts. Drizzle remaining dressing.
recipes.tip: Roasting beets in foil makes them steam-roast - much sweeter than boiling. Skin slips off with a paper towel once cooled.
recipes.tip2: To avoid staining everything magenta, dress the beets separately and add them last. Or embrace it and toss everything together — it all turns a beautiful pink anyway.
recipe_detailed: Wrap beets individually in foil with a drizzle of olive oil. Roast at 400F for 45-60 min until a knife slides in without resistance. Cool, then rub the skins off with a paper towel.
Make honey-Dijon vinaigrette: whisk together Dijon, honey, red wine vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Toast walnuts in a dry pan 3-4 min until golden and smelling nutty. Watch them — they burn fast.
Arrange arugula on a platter. Slice beets and add. Scatter crumbled feta and toasted walnuts. Drizzle dressing just before serving and toss gently at the table.

recipes.name: Mushroom & Spinach Quesadillas
recipes.desc: Crispy flour tortillas filled with sautéed mushrooms, wilted spinach, and melted pepper jack
recipe: Sauté onion. Add mushrooms, cook over HIGH heat without stirring until golden, 5 min. Add garlic, paprika, cumin, salt.
Add spinach, wilt 1 min. Layer filling on half of each tortilla, top with cheese, fold.
Cook in buttered pan 2-3 min per side until crispy. Serve with sour cream and guac.
recipes.tip: High heat without stirring is everything for mushrooms - they need to brown, not steam.
recipes.tip2: Cook the filling completely before adding it to the quesadilla — you only have 2-3 min of pan time for the cheese to melt and the tortilla to crisp. Any underdone filling stays underdone.
recipe_detailed: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add mushrooms in a single layer — cook without stirring 3 min until browned on one side. Stir and cook 2 more min. Season with salt.
Add garlic and spinach. Stir until spinach wilts, 1-2 min. Season and let any excess moisture cook off completely. The filling should be dry, not watery.
Heat a clean skillet over medium. Place a tortilla flat. Add cheese on half, then the filling, then more cheese. Fold in half.
Cook 2-3 min per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy and the cheese is fully melted. Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream, guacamole, and salsa.

recipes.name: Lemon Ricotta Pasta
recipes.desc: Silky pasta with whipped ricotta, lemon, fresh basil, and toasted pine nuts - ready in 20 minutes
ingredients: Salt, black pepper, red pepper flakes
recipe: Cook pasta in heavily salted water. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Whip ricotta with lemon zest, juice, parmesan, olive oil, salt, pepper until smooth.
Toss hot pasta with garlic and olive oil. Add ricotta and pasta water a splash at a time until creamy. Fold in basil. Top with pine nuts.
recipes.tip: Starchy pasta water turns ricotta into a sauce - add a splash at a time until it coats the noodles like cream.
recipes.tip2: Reserve more pasta water than you think you need — at least a full cup. Ricotta is thick and the starchy pasta water is what makes it flow into a silky sauce rather than clumping.
recipe_detailed: Cook pasta in generously salted water. Reserve at least 1 cup pasta water before draining.
In a large bowl, mix ricotta with lemon zest, lemon juice, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Taste — it should be bright and creamy.
Add hot drained pasta to the ricotta bowl. Toss vigorously, adding pasta water a splash at a time until the sauce is silky and coats every strand.
Finish with Parmesan, more lemon zest, black pepper, and fresh basil. Serve immediately — ricotta pasta tightens up as it cools.

recipes.name: Pumpkin & Black Bean Enchiladas
recipes.desc: Corn tortillas filled with spiced pumpkin and black beans, smothered in red sauce and cheese
recipe: Mix pumpkin, beans, corn, spices, 1/4 cup enchilada sauce. Season. Warm tortillas in dry pan.
Fill, roll, place seam-side down in greased 9x13 dish. Pour remaining sauce over. Top with cheese.
Bake at 375°F 25 min until bubbling. Top with sour cream, green onion, cilantro.
recipes.tip: Warm tortillas before rolling - cold corn tortillas crack and split.
recipes.tip2: Dip each tortilla briefly in warm sauce before rolling — it softens it and prevents cracking when you fold, plus builds flavor into the tortilla itself.
recipe_detailed: Make enchilada sauce: saute onion and garlic, add chili powder, cumin, and oregano, then tomato sauce and broth. Simmer 10 min until slightly thickened. Season.
Make filling: mix pumpkin puree with drained black beans, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Warm tortillas briefly in a dry pan so they are pliable. Dip each in warm sauce, fill with the pumpkin-bean mixture and a little cheese, roll tightly and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour remaining sauce over the enchiladas. Scatter cheese over the top. Bake at 375F for 25 min until bubbly. Top with sour cream, avocado, and cilantro.

recipes.name: Roasted Cauliflower Steaks
recipes.desc: Thick-cut cauliflower steaks roasted with harissa, chickpeas, and tahini dressing
recipe: Slice cauliflower into 1-inch steaks. Brush with harissa and 2 tbsp oil. Season. Toss chickpeas with remaining oil, cumin, paprika, salt on the same pan.
Roast at 425°F 30 min, flipping cauliflower once, until charred at edges.
Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic, water into sauce. Drizzle over steaks. Top with parsley and pomegranate.
recipes.tip: Roast at the highest heat your oven can do - the char on the edges is the entire point.
recipes.tip2: Sear the cauliflower steaks in a hot pan before roasting — 2 min per side in olive oil. The oven alone gives you color, but the sear gives you a Maillard-browned, nutty crust.
recipe_detailed: Cut the cauliflower vertically into 1-inch steaks. You will get 2-3 good steaks from the center. Pat dry.
Season both sides with olive oil, salt, pepper, and your spices. Heat an oven-safe skillet over high heat. Sear steaks 2 min per side until golden.
Transfer skillet to 425F oven and roast 15-20 min until tender through the core. Test with a thin knife — it should slide through without resistance.
Serve over hummus or grain, drizzled with tahini, pomegranate seeds, toasted pine nuts, and fresh herbs.

recipes.name: Mujaddara
recipes.desc: A humble but extraordinary Middle Eastern dish of lentils and rice with deeply caramelized onions
recipe: Cook lentils in salted water 20 min until almost tender. Drain, reserve liquid.
Cook onions in oil over medium-low with a pinch of salt for 35-40 min until deeply golden and jammy.
Remove half the onions. Add lentils, rice, spices to pan. Add reserved liquid. Cover, simmer 18 min.
Top with reserved caramelized onions. Serve with yogurt and parsley.
recipes.tip: 40 minutes for the onions is not an exaggeration. Patience transforms humble ingredients.
recipes.tip2: The crispy onions are not a garnish — they are the whole point. Cook them in enough oil at medium heat for 20-25 min until deeply golden and caramelized. Under-done onions on mujaddara is like a burger without a patty.
recipe_detailed: Cook lentils in salted water 20 min until tender but not mushy. Drain.

Meanwhile, caramelize onions: slice thinly and cook in olive oil over medium heat for 20-25 min, stirring frequently, until deep golden-brown. Season with salt. Don't rush — this is the heart of the dish.
Cook rice separately until fluffy. Combine lentils and rice, season well with cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, and pepper.
Serve topped very generously with the caramelized onions. Add a dollop of plain yogurt and fresh herbs.

recipes.name: Chickpea Stew with Feta
recipes.desc: A Spanish-inspired quick stew of chickpeas in smoky tomato broth with wilted greens and feta
recipe: Sauté onion 5 min. Add garlic and spices, cook 1 min. Add tomatoes and broth. Simmer 10 min.
Smash a handful of chickpeas against the pot to thicken. Add remaining chickpeas. Simmer 8 min.
Add greens, wilt 2 min. Top with feta. Serve with bread.
recipes.tip: Smashing some chickpeas is what makes this thick and creamy instead of brothy.
recipes.tip2: Add the feta after plating, not into the pot — it dissolves and disappears if you stir it into the hot stew. Added cold on top, it stays in creamy chunks and you get bursts of salty richness in every bite.
recipe_detailed: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Cook onion and garlic 5 min until soft. Add tomato paste and cook 1-2 min until it darkens slightly.
Add drained chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, broth, and spices. Stir and bring to a simmer. Cook 20 min uncovered until the sauce reduces and thickens.
Add spinach and stir until wilted. Taste and season. A splash of red wine vinegar at the end brightens it.
Ladle into bowls and top with crumbled feta, a drizzle of good olive oil, and crusty bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Shakshuka Verde
recipes.desc: A green twist on shakshuka - eggs poached in tomatillo, jalapeño, and spinach sauce
recipe: Blend tomatillos and jalapeños until smooth. Heat oil. Cook onion and garlic until soft. Add cumin, coriander.
Pour in tomatillo sauce. Simmer 8 min until almost jammy. Add spinach, wilt.
Make 6 wells. Crack an egg into each. Cover and cook 5-7 min. Top with cotija, cilantro. Serve with tortillas.
recipes.tip: Let the tomatillo sauce cook down until almost jammy before adding the eggs - this concentrates flavor and prevents a watery result.
recipes.tip2: Tomatillos are naturally acidic and bitter raw. A short simmer after adding them is enough to mellow the bitterness — taste the sauce before adding eggs and adjust salt and a pinch of sugar if needed.
recipe_detailed: Husk and rinse tomatillos — they are sticky, rinse thoroughly. Quarter or roughly chop. Saute onion, garlic, and jalapeno in oil until soft. Add tomatillos and cook 5 min until they break down into a sauce.
Add cumin, salt, and a handful of cilantro. Use an immersion blender to blend partially — a slightly rough texture is nice. Taste and adjust salt, lime juice, or a pinch of sugar to balance.
Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer. Make shallow wells and crack eggs in. Cover and cook 5-7 min until whites are set and yolks are still runny.
Top with crumbled cotija or feta, extra cilantro, sliced avocado, and warm corn tortillas on the side.

recipes.name: Polenta Florentine
recipes.desc: Creamy soft polenta topped with garlicky sauteed spinach, a poached egg, and shaved Parmesan.
recipe: Bring 6 cups salted water to a boil. Whisk in polenta, reduce heat, stir 5 min. Cook on low 15-20 min stirring often until thick and creamy.
Stir in butter and Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper. Keep warm.
Saute garlic in olive oil 1 min. Add spinach in batches, cook until wilted 3-4 min. Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Poach eggs in barely simmering water with a splash of vinegar, 3 min for runny yolks.
Spoon polenta into bowls, top with spinach, a poached egg, and extra Parmesan.
recipes.tip: Use a wide pan and plenty of water for poaching - fresh eggs hold together best.

recipes.name: Lentil Bolognese
recipes.desc: Rich lentil & tomato ragu over pappardelle with Parmesan.
recipe: Saute diced onion, carrot, celery in olive oil 8 min.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and oregano, cook 2 min.
Add lentils, tomatoes, and 2 cups water. Simmer 25 min.
Toss with cooked pasta and Parmesan.
recipes.tip: Use red lentils for a creamier sauce.
recipes.tip2: Don't rush the soffritto at the start — the onion, carrot, and celery need a full 8 min to soften and sweeten. This is the flavor base the whole dish is built on.
recipe_detailed: Finely dice onion, carrot, and celery into roughly equal small pieces. Cook in olive oil over medium heat 8-10 min, stirring occasionally, until very soft and the onion is translucent.
Add garlic and tomato paste, cook 2 min until the paste darkens slightly.

Add lentils, crushed tomatoes, and 2 cups water or broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer. Cook 25-30 min, stirring occasionally, until lentils are completely soft and the sauce is thick.
Cook pappardelle in heavily salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining. Toss pasta with the ragu, adding pasta water to loosen. Finish with Parmesan and olive oil.

recipes.name: Black Bean Burgers
recipes.desc: Smoky black bean patties with avocado and chipotle mayo on brioche.
recipe: Mash beans, mix with breadcrumbs, egg, and spices. Form 4 patties.
Chill 15 min. Pan-fry in oil 4 min per side until crisp.
Serve on buns with avocado and chipotle mayo.
recipes.tip: Chilling the patties before cooking helps them hold together.
recipes.tip2: Over-mashing the beans makes a dense, gummy patty. Mash only until most beans are broken but some chunks remain — the texture of partly whole beans is what holds the patty together.
recipe_detailed: Drain and rinse beans thoroughly, then spread on a baking sheet and bake at 350F for 10 min — this dries them out slightly and makes for a firmer patty.
Mash beans roughly — stop when you still have some visible chunks. Overmashing creates a gummy, wet paste that won't hold a patty shape.
Mix with breadcrumbs, egg, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt. The mixture should hold its shape when squeezed. If too wet, add more breadcrumbs.
Form into patties, refrigerate 15-30 min, then pan-fry in oil over medium 4 min per side until deeply golden and crispy on both faces.

recipes.name: Tofu Stir-Fry with Bok Choy
recipes.desc: Crispy tofu and bok choy in a ginger-sesame sauce over rice.
recipe: Cube and pan-fry tofu until golden, ~10 min.
Whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, ginger, garlic, cornstarch.
Add bok choy, cook 3 min. Pour sauce, toss until thickened.
Serve over rice.
recipes.tip: Press tofu at least 30 min for best crispiness.
recipes.tip2: Pat the tofu dry multiple times with paper towels even after pressing. Any surface moisture creates steam in the pan and prevents browning.
recipe_detailed: Press tofu for 30 min under a weighted towel. Then pat dry again with paper towels. Cut into cubes. Toss lightly with cornstarch and salt — the cornstarch creates a thin crust.

Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high until shimmering. Add tofu in a single layer. Don't touch for 3-4 min until the bottom is deeply golden and releases naturally. Flip and cook 2 more min on each side.
Make sauce: whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic, and cornstarch.
In the same pan, cook halved baby bok choy cut-side down 2 min until charred. Add sauce and tofu, toss 1-2 min until sauce thickens and coats everything. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Margherita Flatbread Pizza
recipes.desc: Crispy flatbreads with San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil.
recipe: Preheat oven to 450F. Rub flatbreads with garlic and olive oil.
Spread tomatoes, top with mozzarella.
Bake 10-12 min until cheese bubbles.
Top with fresh basil.
recipes.tip: Add red pepper flakes for heat.
recipes.tip2: Less is more with Margherita. Restrain the toppings — a thin spread of crushed tomato, a few torn pieces of mozzarella, and a small drizzle of olive oil. Overloaded flatbread steams and turns soggy.
recipe_detailed: Preheat oven to 450F with a baking sheet inside — you want the surface already hot.
Rub flatbreads with a cut garlic clove and a light brush of olive oil.
Spread a thin layer of crushed San Marzano tomatoes. Don't spread all the way to the edges — leave a half-inch border. Tear mozzarella into pieces and scatter — leave gaps.

Bake 10-12 min until cheese is melted and bubbly with some golden spots and the edges are crispy. Remove and immediately top with fresh basil added after baking. A drizzle of olive oil and flaky salt to finish.

recipes.name: Vegetable Gyoza
recipes.desc: Pan-fried dumplings filled with cabbage, shiitake, and ginger.
recipe: Salt cabbage, rest 10 min, squeeze dry. Mix with mushrooms, scallions, ginger, soy, sesame oil.
Fill wrappers with 1 tsp filling, fold and pleat to seal.
Pan-fry flat side down 3 min. Add water, cover, steam 4 min.
Serve with dipping sauce.
recipes.tip: Freeze extras in a single layer before bagging.
recipes.tip2: The pan-fry then steam technique gives you the best of both worlds: a crispy, golden bottom and a tender, steamed top. Use a lid that fits tightly — the steam is what finishes the filling.
recipe_detailed: Salt shredded cabbage, let sit 10 min, then squeeze very dry in a towel. Mix with minced shiitake mushrooms also squeezed dry, scallions, ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Fill each wrapper with about 1 teaspoon of filling. Moisten the edge with water, fold in half, and pleat the front edge to seal. They should stand flat with a curved shape.
Heat oil in a flat-bottomed skillet over medium-high. Place gyoza flat-side down in a single layer. Cook 2-3 min until the bottoms are golden and crispy.

Add enough water to come a quarter inch up the gyoza. Cover immediately with a tight lid. Steam 4 min. Remove lid, let any remaining water evaporate, and cook 1 more minute. Serve with soy sauce, rice vinegar, and chili oil.

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.desc: Peppers filled with quinoa, black beans, corn, and melted cheese.
recipe: Preheat oven to 375F. Hollow out peppers.
Mix quinoa, beans, corn, salsa, and cumin.
Fill peppers, top with cheese. Bake 30 min.
Garnish with cilantro.
recipes.tip: Add a jalapeno to the filling for heat.
recipes.tip2: Pre-bake the empty pepper halves 10 min before stuffing — they will be tender all the way through when the filling is done, rather than underdone and crunchy around the finished filling.
recipe_detailed: Halve peppers lengthwise, remove seeds. Place cut-side up on a baking sheet, brush with oil, and roast at 400F for 10 min — just enough to soften slightly.
Mix filling: cooked quinoa, drained black beans, corn, salsa, cumin, and salt. Taste — it should be well-seasoned on its own.
Spoon filling generously into each pepper half, mounding it slightly. Top each with shredded cheese.
Return to 375F oven and bake 25 min until filling is heated through and cheese is melted. Rest 5 min before serving. Top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.desc: Creamy arborio rice with mixed mushrooms and Parmesan.
recipe: Saute shallot in butter. Add cremini, cook until golden.
Add rice, stir 1 min. Deglaze with wine.
Add porcini liquid then broth one ladle at a time, stirring 25 min.
Stir in Parmesan and butter. Rest 2 min.
recipes.tip: Never rinse arborio - the starch makes it creamy.
recipes.tip2: The stirring serves a purpose — it rubs the starch off the rice grains into the cooking liquid, which is how you get that characteristic creamy texture. But constant stirring is not required; stir frequently, not constantly.
recipe_detailed: Soak dried porcini in 2 cups hot water for 15 min. Squeeze mushrooms out and save the soaking liquid — strain it through a paper towel to remove grit.
Saute shallot in butter until soft and translucent. Add fresh cremini mushrooms and cook until golden, 5-6 min. Add garlic and porcini, cook 1 min. Remove mushrooms and set aside.
Add arborio rice to the same pan and stir 1 min until the edges turn translucent. Deglaze with white wine and stir until absorbed.

Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring and waiting for each addition to absorb before adding the next — about 20 min. Use the porcini soaking liquid as part of the total liquid. When rice is al dente and sauce is creamy, remove from heat. Stir in cold butter and Parmesan. Rest 2 min.

recipes.name: Veggie Sushi Bowls
recipes.desc: Sushi rice with avocado, cucumber, edamame, and pickled ginger.
recipe: Cook rice. Mix vinegar and sugar; fold into warm rice.
Slice avocado and cucumber.
Build bowls: rice, avocado, cucumber, edamame, ginger, nori.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sriracha mayo.
recipes.tip: A rice cooker makes perfectly sticky sushi rice.
recipes.tip2: Season sushi rice while it is still very warm — the starch cells are open and it absorbs the vinegar seasoning much better than cold rice. Mix gently with a wooden spoon using folding motions, not stirring.
recipe_detailed: Rinse sushi rice until water runs clear. Cook per package. While still hot, mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt until dissolved. Fold gently into the rice with a wooden spoon. The rice should be glossy and slightly sticky.
Slice avocado and cucumber just before serving — both deteriorate quickly if cut too far ahead.
Make sriracha mayo: whisk sriracha with mayo. Thin with a little water if you want it drizzle-able.
Build bowls: rice base, then arranged sections of avocado, cucumber, edamame, and pickled ginger. Lay torn nori over everything. Drizzle with soy sauce and sriracha mayo. Eat immediately.

recipes.name: Falafel Bowls
recipes.desc: Crispy baked falafel over rice with tzatziki, tomatoes, and cucumbers.
recipe: Pulse chickpeas, parsley, garlic, and spices. Mix in flour.
Form balls, bake at 425F 25 min, flipping halfway.
Serve over rice with tzatziki, tomatoes, and cucumber.
recipes.tip: Dried chickpeas make crispier falafel than canned.
recipes.tip2: Use dried chickpeas soaked overnight — not canned. Canned chickpeas are too wet and the falafel will fall apart. Dried soaked chickpeas are raw but softened, which gives the right texture to hold a ball shape.
recipe_detailed: Soak dried chickpeas in cold water overnight. Drain completely — they should be plump but still raw.

Pulse drained chickpeas, parsley, cilantro, garlic, onion, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper in a food processor until it resembles coarse wet sand — not a smooth paste. Add flour and pulse to combine.
Form into balls or patties. Bake at 425F on an oiled baking sheet 25 min, flipping once, until deeply golden and firm. Or fry in 350F oil for 3 min until golden.
Serve over rice with tzatziki, halved cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and warm pita. Drizzle everything with tahini sauce: tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and water to thin.

recipes.name: Pad Thai with Tofu
recipes.desc: Classic pad thai with pressed tofu, rice noodles, peanuts, and tamarind sauce.
recipe: Soak noodles 10 min. Mix tamarind, soy, sugar, and lime.
Fry tofu until golden. Push aside, scramble eggs.
Add noodles and sauce, toss 3 min. Add sprouts and scallions.
Top with peanuts and lime wedges.
recipes.tip: High heat is essential - use a wok if you have one.
recipes.tip2: Add the noodles last and toss quickly — they need only 2-3 min once they hit the hot pan. Overcooked pad thai noodles turn mushy and clump together. When in doubt, undercook slightly in the soak step.
recipe_detailed: Soak rice noodles in room temperature water 30 min until pliable but still firm — they finish cooking in the pan. Don't soak in boiling water or they overcook.
Press tofu dry, cube, and fry in oil until golden and slightly crispy, 6-8 min. Remove and set aside.
Make sauce: whisk tamarind paste, fish sauce or soy for vegan, brown sugar, and lime juice. It should taste bold — intensely sour, sweet, and savory.

In a very hot wok, add oil, then drained noodles, then sauce. Toss 2 min. Push to sides, scramble eggs in center, then mix through. Add tofu, bean sprouts, and scallions. Toss 1 min. Top with roasted peanuts, lime, and fresh chili.

recipes.name: Butternut Squash Soup
recipes.desc: Silky roasted butternut squash soup with coconut milk and toasted pepitas.
recipe: Roast squash at 425F with olive oil 25 min.
Saute onion and garlic. Add squash, broth, spices. Simmer 10 min.
Blend until smooth. Stir in coconut milk.
Top with toasted pepitas.
recipes.tip: Roasting first adds depth you cannot get from boiling.
recipes.tip2: Roasting concentrates flavor through caramelization — don't skip it for boiling to save time. The golden edges on the roasted squash add a depth of sweetness that boiled squash simply doesn't have.
recipe_detailed: Peel and cube butternut squash into roughly even pieces. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan with space between pieces. Roast at 425F for 25-30 min until golden and caramelized on the edges.
Meanwhile, cook onion in butter or oil until soft, 5 min. Add garlic and cook 1 min.
Add roasted squash, broth, and spices. Simmer 10 min together to marry the flavors. Blend until completely smooth.
Stir in coconut milk and heat gently — don't boil after adding coconut milk. Taste and adjust salt. Serve topped with toasted pepitas and a drizzle of coconut milk.

recipes.name: White Bean and Kale Soup
recipes.desc: Tuscan-style soup with cannellini beans, kale, and a Parmesan rind.
recipe: Saute onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, broth, beans, and Parmesan rind.
Simmer 15 min. Add kale, cook 5 min.
Remove rind. Season with salt and red pepper flakes.
Serve with crusty bread.
recipes.tip: The Parmesan rind adds remarkable umami depth.
recipes.tip2: Keep the Parmesan rind in the whole time it simmers — it won't fully melt but it slowly releases a rich, savory umami that builds the broth's body. Remove it before serving.
recipe_detailed: Saute onion in olive oil until soft, 5 min. Add garlic and fresh rosemary and cook 1 min.
Add drained cannellini beans, diced tomatoes, broth, and the Parmesan rind. The rind slowly dissolves rich depth into the broth.
Simmer 15 min. Add chopped kale and stir until wilted, 3-5 min. The kale should be bright green and tender but still have some texture.
Remove the Parmesan rind. Season generously with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Finish with a drizzle of good olive oil. Serve with crusty bread for dunking.

recipes.name: Tempeh Tacos
recipes.desc: Crumbled tempeh with taco spices in corn tortillas with avocado and slaw.
recipe: Crumble tempeh, cook in oil 5 min until browned.
Add taco seasoning, soy sauce, and splash of water. Cook 3 min.
Fill warm tortillas with tempeh, cabbage, pico, and avocado.
Finish with lime juice.
recipes.tip: Steam tempeh 10 min before cooking to remove bitterness.
recipes.tip2: Steam the tempeh before cooking to remove its natural bitterness. 10 min in a steamer or microwave with a splash of water softens it and opens the structure so it absorbs the taco seasoning.
recipe_detailed: Steam tempeh for 10 min — place in a steamer basket or microwave in a bowl with 2 tablespoons water, covered, for 3 min. Let cool slightly, then crumble into rough pieces.
Cook crumbled tempeh in oil over medium-high heat 4-5 min until golden and starting to crisp.
Add taco seasoning and soy sauce with a splash of water. Stir and cook 2-3 min until the liquid evaporates and the spices cling to the tempeh.
Warm corn tortillas over a flame or dry pan. Fill with tempeh, shredded cabbage, pico de gallo, and avocado. Squeeze lime over everything.

recipes.name: Caprese Pesto Pasta
recipes.desc: Pasta with fresh basil pesto, cherry tomatoes, and torn mozzarella.
recipe: Cook pasta in salted water, reserve 0.5 cup pasta water.
Toss drained pasta with pesto, adding pasta water to loosen.
Fold in tomatoes and mozzarella.
Top with fresh basil and olive oil.
recipes.tip: Pasta water starch helps the pesto cling to every piece.
recipes.tip2: Never heat pesto — the fresh basil will oxidize and turn an unappetizing brown-grey. Always add it off the heat and let the warm pasta and pasta water bring it together.
recipe_detailed: Cook pasta in heavily salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve at least 3/4 cup starchy pasta water before draining.
Drain pasta and return to the pot off the heat immediately. Add pesto and toss — do not put it back on the burner.
Add pasta water a splash at a time, tossing continuously, until the pesto loosens into a silky sauce that coats every piece.
Fold in halved cherry tomatoes and torn fresh mozzarella. Add fresh basil at the very end and toss once more. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
recipes.desc: Coconut milk curry with chickpeas, sweet potato, and spinach over basmati.
